fieldDescription: Particles in slipspace ruptures, blinks and Ark portals. [Lower] is faster.
Screen-warp rings around slipspace ruptures and portals. Off skips a [full-screen copy] each frame while one is open.
Refraction rings on Covenant shields when they are hit. Off skips a [screen copy] per hit ship each frame.
Volume of Covenant impact, shield and slipspace sounds. Weapon fire follows the game's [sound] slider.
